svg.text: McCzarny recently made extensive updates to the
dcvis repository, introducing a new "Power Plan
Usage" tab to visualize data center power
consumption against power plant blocks. He
significantly enhanced water usage analysis,
updating calculations for a 500 MW data center,
comparing it to city residents, and introducing
groundwater productivity information with map
visualizations. He also added a dedicated
"Water" preset and layer, featuring charts,
tables, and proportional circles on the map.
Further developments in dcvis include an
"energy" layer for comparing data center power
consumption to Bełchatów's, and simplifying
the noise chart to display both neutral and
inversion conditions directly. Other
refinements in dcvis involved redoing the
methodology panel, unifying water usage units,
and various UI fixes and data cleanups. In
crater-js, he continued game development by
adding a Cilia Hauler helper mob, implementing
basic impatience, and improving UI item
handling with numeric key selection. He also
tuned character movement, added complex
difficulty logic, and created bedrock for the
game. For his profile repository,
McCzarny/McCzarny, he updated the
generate-summary workflow by adding a
GITHUB_TOKEN. Finally, in
chromium-daily-digest, he added more log
context and a missing summary.
